statements.status_notes: CVE-2015-5237 is an integer overflow in protobuf's MessageLite serialization when a message exceeds 2 GiB (upstream report: https://github.com/protocolbuffers/protobuf/issues/760). Upstream addressed it in protobuf 3.4.0 by sizing messages with ByteSizeLong() and refusing to serialize when the size exceeds INT_MAX; the maintainers state in that issue that the change first shipped in v3.4.0. The Debian 13 source this package is built from is upstream 3.21.12, and its src/google/protobuf/message_lite.cc carries that check in SerializePartialToCodedStream, SerializePartialToZeroCopyStream, AppendPartialToString and SerializePartialToArray (https://github.com/protocolbuffers/protobuf/blob/v3.21.12/src/google/protobuf/message_lite.cc). Every published build of this package is based on 3.21.12 and contains the fix; the range boundary is the currently published package version. Debian's tracker records no fixed version because it rates the issue unimportant (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2015-5237).
